strategy.name: intraday_sma_trained_fixed_2003_2013
strategy.description: 把仅用 SPY 1993-01-29～2002-12-31 训练选出的唯一双侧邻域代表完整冻结，在紧接其后的 2003-01-02～2013-12-31 运行一次锁定样本外测试；窗口前历史只预热指标，本实验不搜索、不扰动、不依据结果替换参数。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓时 OR：已有卖出价后，价格达到卖出成交价上方 9.25% 则强制买回；价格向上穿越动态 SMA156；价格向上穿越 SMA12/22/32 三线平均值下方 4.4%。没有历史卖出价时，强制买回不可产生第一笔买入。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：价格低于成本价 19.25%；SMA12/22/32 三线平均变化率连续 7 日为负且价格跌破动态 SMA150；此前连续 8 日三线平均变化率为负且当日 SMA12、SMA22、SMA32 各自变化率全部不高于 -0.55%；价格向下穿越动态 SMA152。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前只使用截至前一交易日 Close 的完整历史解出当日条件单阈值；2003 年前数据只用于指标预热，窗口前禁止交易。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日常规时段 Open 已越过阈值，按当日 Open 成交；否则常规时段调整后 OHLC 触及预先解出的理论阈值时按该阈值成交；每天最多一笔。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only；初始 100,000 美元现金，每次在全仓 SPY 与全现金之间切换，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 2003-01-02 起独立空仓等待第一笔普通买入，不继承训练期末仓位、成本或卖出锚；完整窗口包含等待首买的现金期。

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: At the 2003-01-02 regular-session Open, invest the same 100,000 USD in SPY and hold through the 2013-12-31 Close. Strategy and benchmark use identical evaluation dates; the strategy's initial cash waiting period remains part of performance.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged. The fixed-case performance, annual-return, signal-reason, K-line, zoom, visible-axis, rebasing and DCA controls already match this locked test.

research.hypothesis: The stable parameter representative selected without any post-2002 information retains useful absolute and risk-adjusted performance during the first eleven years of the untouched period.
research.primary_metric: Report the single frozen case's complete-window CAGR and Sharpe against identical-window SPY Buy & Hold, with total return, maximum drawdown, exposure, annual returns and order count as supporting diagnostics.
research.selection_rule: None in this experiment. Evaluate exactly one parameter vector copied from training run run_20260813T183932Z_ee00baab; do not search, rank, perturb or replace it after observing 2003–2013.
research.validation_plan: The fixed case must match PyBroker and the independent pandas ledger on daily cash, shares, equity, order dates, sides, shares, fills and trade accounting within 1e-6; the first order must be ordinary, pre-2003 rows may only warm indicators, and daily orders cannot exceed one.
research.promotion_criteria: Treat this as evidence about one locked post-training window only. A favorable result may support retaining the frozen strategy for a separately authorized 2014+ test or paper-trading design, but does not authorize parameter changes or live trading.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject the run if any frozen parameter differs from the training representative, the test inherits training state, any pre-window row trades, the first order is seeded or forced re-entry, daily orders exceed one, Buy & Hold uses another window, data is unapproved, or PyBroker and the independent ledger diverge.
